body:
Hey there! Writing is eating up your time—whether it's email copy, blog posts, or ad text. This week we're rounding up the best AI writing assistants that actually deliver results for small business owners.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI**
Write, edit, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. 
*Best for:* Teams already using Notion who want writing help built right in.
*Price:* Free + $10/mo
[Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy in seconds—emails, social posts, product descriptions.
*Best for:* Solopreneurs and small teams cranking out multiple campaigns.
*Price:* Free + $36/mo
[Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Write content that ranks on Google by optimizing for search intent and keywords.
*Best for:* Owners serious about organic traffic who need data-driven writing.
*Price:* $89/mo
[Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Quick Tip**
AI writing tools work best when you give them *specific* context. Instead of "write a product description," try "write a 50-word product description for small business owners, emphasizing time-saving benefits, in a friendly but professional tone." The more detail you provide, the better the output—and the less editing you'll do.
